bijan_zzz: Nils "Mud" Zzz came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

A single shot from across the wire hit Nils "Mud" Zzz in the thigh at R-R11. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Walter "Button" Jmw of the Concord (@jmw094). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Nils "Mud" Zzz fell at R-R11 and never moved again. Shot by Walter "Button" Jmw of the Concord (@jmw094).
Dietrich Zzz had heard about Nils "Mud" Zzz's courage. At R-R11, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

Dietrich Zzz fired a burst, moved the gun ten yards, and fired again before the enemy could reply. Karel Man was gravely wounded. Dietrich Zzz fed a new belt into the gun and laid it on the enemy path at R-R11. Before dawn Emil Kevinkukhta walked into it, badly wounded.
cnfilip77: Nobody asked Yann Cnfilip why he came. Nobody in T-F9 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

Yann Cnfilip saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at T-F9 and fired once. Lucien "Brick" Rykaczewski was grazed. A shell burst directly over T-F9. Yann Cnfilip was found under the duckboards, alive, but only just. The orderlies scrubbed a bed in the hospital dugout and called for Yann Cnfilip. He was asleep before they set him down. Yann Cnfilip's fever broke in the night. The orderly checked the chart twice and smiled for the first time in a week. A letter from home reached Yann Cnfilip before dusk. Yann Cnfilip read it twice and slept a little easier.
domgas_1: Day 8: Dietrich "Spark" Domgas reached R-S16 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Dietrich "Spark" Domgas asked if second helpings depended on the answer.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Dietrich "Spark" Domgas watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
The mud froze hard overnight. For one morning Dietrich "Spark" Domgas could walk on top of it, like a man walking on water.
faccio.stefano: The draft reached R-C10 on Day 9. Gustav "Mud" Stefano was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

Gustav "Mud" Stefano let three easy targets go by. The fourth was the one worth the risk. Valentin "Shadow" Aloofcardina was grazed. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Gustav "Mud" Stefano read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
A clear shot from R-C10. Gustav "Mud" Stefano badly wounded Karel Check and slid back down below the parapet.
george_jackson2004: Dietrich Jackson came from Oakmere, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
Dietrich Jackson received the First Wave ribbon. He checked the stitching twice before putting the tunic back on.
On Day 3, Verdel Ridge passed to the Concord. Dietrich Jackson wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Dietrich Jackson spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection.
Dietrich Jackson got a letter from Clara. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.

Rain washed the chalk names from the trench signs. Dietrich Jackson spent the evening directing strangers past the same junction. News of the loss of Hill 304 reached R-F10 with the rations. Dietrich Jackson ate while listening to the revised orders.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F10 and grazed Dietrich Jackson's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Marek Ditrih of the Hegemony (@ditrih_88).
Dietrich Jackson no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Dietrich Jackson wrote back to Clara and tore it up three times. The fourth version says almost nothing, which is how he knows it is the right one.
Dietrich Jackson sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Dietrich Jackson wrote to a teacher who said he would amount to nothing that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
No post for Dietrich Jackson this week. He checks the sack anyway, every day, and pretends he was only looking for tobacco.
gmt_zhai: Yann Zhai reached R-R3 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Yann Zhai looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A beetle crawled across Yann Zhai's sleeve during the long wait. He could do nothing about it without giving away the position.
hexofdex: Day 10: Dorian Hexofdex reached P-F20 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
Dorian Hexofdex tried to remember the sound of the church bell in Port Abel. Every version sounded like the ration bell.
kurlkale: Felix "Bones" Kurlkale reached S-C11 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

Felix "Bones" Kurlkale counted the steps of the Concord sentry, waited for the turn, and went in. Leopold "Brick" Moovin never saw the shovel coming. (@da_moovin) Twenty yards of mud, one gap in the wire, one jump. Felix "Bones" Kurlkale landed next to Tobias Lakam in the Concord trench. Only Felix "Bones" Kurlkale climbed back out. (@kil.lakam20) The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at S-C11 changed before the cheering ended. Felix "Bones" Kurlkale shouldered another load. A letter from home reached Felix "Bones" Kurlkale before dusk. Felix "Bones" Kurlkale read it twice and slept a little easier.

Felix "Bones" Kurlkale won a week of rum at cards from a lance corporal in S-C11. The lance corporal wants a rematch. A letter from home reached Felix "Bones" Kurlkale before dusk. Felix "Bones" Kurlkale read it twice and slept a little easier.
manny_lopez.18: The quartermaster asked Otto Lopez to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Otto Lopez shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Gustav Vandahinten, was badly wounded.
realvirtuality: Tobias Realvirtuali came up the line with a key to a house that is no longer there and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.

Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Tobias Realvirtuali stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores. A letter from home reached Tobias Realvirtuali before dusk. Tobias Realvirtuali read it twice and slept a little easier. Orders came through: Tobias Realvirtuali is a rifleman now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a key to a house that is no longer there.

Tobias Realvirtuali drew a map of Severin "Doc" Justinsoups's hometown from Doc's stories. Doc says it is wrong in every detail, and carries it everywhere. A letter from home reached Tobias Realvirtuali before dusk. Tobias Realvirtuali read it twice and slept a little easier.
samot0423: Roland Samot reached T-F21 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Roland Samot wrote to his mother, who writes every Sunday that night and said only: 'We will take it back.' A letter from home reached Roland Samot before dusk. Roland Samot read it twice and slept a little easier.

Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Roland Samot read a theatre review while peeling supper. A letter from home reached Roland Samot before dusk. Roland Samot read it twice and slept a little easier.
tru_og_fokai: Dietrich Fokai unpacked a rosary of rough beads at S-R14. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.

Dietrich Fokai saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at S-R14 and fired once. Henrik Somka was grazed. From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Dietrich Fokai wrote to his mother, who writes every Sunday that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Dietrich Fokai changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument.
